content_of_post_to_comment: always an evocative and bittersweet thing to see in an eagerly awaited interlibrary loan book It’s been a lonely 46 years my friend, but don’t worry, we found each other, and I am thrilled to read you
comment: There’s a quiet mystery in these reunions: a book’s journey doesn’t end when it leaves its first reader. I wonder how many forgotten works are still waiting for their second life.
